lina-peopleops: Heads up everyone — due to this morning's auth outage we are opening a 48-hour submission extension window. New hard close: +48h from original EOD. Please read the quick rules below and acknowledge. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam-manager: Thank you — huge help. Does this mean ratings already submitted can be edited during the extension?

lina-peopleops: Short answer: yes, with guardrails. Rules: 1) managers can revise ratings/comments until final close (we'll keep an edit audit) 2) any rating change after calibration requires a short free-text "reason for change" 3) final calibration facilitator will get a flagged report of post-calibration edits.

dave-eng: For transparency, will the calibration spreadsheet show previous values or only final? We need diffs for auditors.

olivia-hr: We'll keep the full edit history in the export. The calibration workbook will include a "change_log" tab with prev_value, new_value, actor, ts. Ops will run export snapshots before and after.

tess-lead: Also, we pushed a small wording change to the rubric this morning (clarified "impact" vs "scope") — do we retroactively apply it? Some managers already used the old descriptors.

lina-peopleops: Good catch. Policy: rubric wording update is clarifying only (no change to numeric weights). We will not retroactively re-score. Calibration facilitators should call out any cases where wording vs previous interpretation caused inconsistent scoring. If needed, we'll normalize during calibration (documented as an adjustment).

sam-manager: If I need to attach a manager note explaining a post-submission change, where does that go?

lina-peopleops: Use the "Edit justification" free-text field in the review UI. If multiple edits, put a single consolidated note referencing the audit entry IDs.

dave-eng: Any changes to the LOA / new-hire rules because of the extension? A hire starts in 7 days and we weren’t including them originally.

olivia-hr: No change to eligibility windows. New-hire inclusion still requires >=14 days active before final close. If the extension makes them eligible, follow the normal partial-cycle flow and tag "extended-window-include" in the CSV.

ops_bot: [Alert] Submission extension enabled: window extended by 48h. Exports scheduled: pre-extension snapshot at 2026-05-17T22:00:00Z, post-extension snapshot at 2026-05-19T22:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

lina-peopleops: Quick ops checklist for the extension: 
- people-ops: enable extension flag, publish note to affected teams
- managers: review and optionally edit ratings; add "Edit justification" for any post-calibration changes
- calibration facilitators: plan 1 extra hour to review post-extension diffs
- eng-ops: run pre/post export and attach to compliance ticket #PR-EXT-342

dave-eng: For folks who already exported local copies, is there a canonical export we should reference?

olivia-hr: Canonical export is the ops snapshot attached to the compliance ticket. Please reference that for any dispute.

sam-manager: Acknowledge — I’ll coordinate with my co-manager to check edits tonight.

lina-peopleops: Thanks. If anything blocks edits (UI throws error or attachments fail), post here and tag @lina-peopleops. We aim to close extended window on schedule. :sparkles:
